orgName: Pacific Grove PONY Baseball and Softball, Inc.

baseballDivisions.name: 6U - Shetland
baseballDivisions.description: Tee ball, played on a 50-foot base distance.
detail: Practices once a week · games on Saturdays

baseballDivisions.name: 8U - Pinto
baseballDivisions.description: Coach pitch moving toward player pitch as the season goes on, played on a 50-foot base distance.
detail: Practices 2–3 days a week · games mostly Saturdays, some weekdays

baseballDivisions.name: 10U - Mustang
baseballDivisions.description: Player-pitch baseball, played on a 60-foot base distance.
detail: Practices 2–3 days a week · games mostly Saturdays, some weekdays

baseballDivisions.name: 12U - Bronco
baseballDivisions.description: Full rules on a bigger field — a 70-foot base distance.
detail: Practices 2–3 days a week · games mostly Saturdays, some weekdays

baseballDivisions.name: 14U - Pony
baseballDivisions.description: Our oldest baseball division, playing a full-size field — an 80-foot base distance.
detail: Practices 2–3 days a week · games mostly Saturdays, some weekdays

softballDivisions.name: 6U - Girls T-ball
softballDivisions.description: The softball equivalent of tee ball — players hit off a tee with a 10" safety ball. Everybody bats and plays different positions.
detail: Practices one weekday a week · games on Saturdays

softballDivisions.name: 8U - Pre-Rookies
softballDivisions.description: Coach-pitch softball as players learn the game, using an 11" safety ball. Everybody bats and plays different positions.
detail: Practices 2–3 times a week · games mostly Saturdays, some weeknights

softballDivisions.name: 10U - Rookies
softballDivisions.description: Kid-pitch softball with balls, strikes and outs, using an 11" medium-hardness ball (RIP-10). Positions start to become assigned.
detail: Practices 2–3 times a week · games throughout the week · playoffs at season's end

softballDivisions.name: 12U - Minors
softballDivisions.description: The next step from Rookies, following full USA Softball rules with a 12" hard ball. Positions become specialized.
detail: Practices 2–3 times a week · games throughout the week · playoffs at season's end

softballDivisions.name: 14U - Majors
softballDivisions.description: Our oldest softball division, playing full USA Softball rules with a 12" hard ball. Positions become specialized.
detail: Practices 2–3 times a week · games throughout the week · playoffs at season's end
